html:
Alexander Lukashenko is the president of Belarus, born in 1954 in Kopys in eastern Belarus, who has ruled since winning the country's first presidential election in 1994.

A former collective farm director, he ran against corruption. Once in power he used referendums to extend his powers and term limits, restored Soviet era symbols and kept much of the economy in state hands. Elections since have not been judged free by outside observers. He signed a union state treaty with Russia in 1999. After the disputed vote of 2020 he crushed the largest protests in the country's history with Russian backing, and in 2022 he let Russian troops invade Ukraine from Belarusian soil.
sum: Alexander Lukashenko is the president of Belarus, born in 1954 in Kopys in eastern Belarus, who has ruled since winning the country's first presidential election in 1994.
